selection_authority: Eight exact Wikimedia Commons files were selected and source-only pixel-audited before any PB6 OCR, semantic, or geometry model call. All eight entity names had zero hits under research/active/l10-r0 and were checked against the prior PB1-PB5 and portal-lattice-fresh-v3 entity inventories.

freeze_rules.identity_profiles: The aliases above are frozen before OCR. Historical names and unrelated co-brands are excluded.
freeze_rules.portal_roles: Rows 1-4 are door-level positives, 5-6 contain no portal pixels, and 7-8 are large open-entrance OOD controls.
freeze_rules.model_access: No OCR, SPPF, portal proposer, or identity model may run before local source integrity and human portal truth are frozen.

claim_boundary: Deliberately identity-opportunity-stratified fresh public-image cohort. It can confirm conditional current-frame identity plus portal proposal behavior, not natural prevalence, physical ownership, public access, traversability, active-view causality, guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
